title: Vertex Flip Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^5; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq W_i \leq 10^9; C_i \in \lbrace 0,1 \rbrace; 1 \leq a_i \lt b_i \leq N; The input graph is a tree.; 1 \leq v \leq N; 1 \leq x \leq 10^9; All input values are integers.
